Site code ↗

Who maintains it

Open contribution. Reviewed publication.

KDV Ecosystems started and maintains this community edition, without claiming established community consensus.

How a proposal gets in

  1. Anyone opens a proposal in the repository.
  2. Automated checks run.
  3. A guardian reviews it; a guardian never approves their own proposal alone.
  4. The change goes into the published version, with a release note.

Guardians

Initial guardian: @ismael-lab.

Initial guardian: ismael-lab. Anyone can propose a change. The published repository governance determines review and acceptance; adding a guardian requires the project owner to authorise access and policy updates. A guardian cannot independently approve their own PR.

Open roadmap

Themes, with no promised dates.

Proposals enter a version after review.

01

Make the first case easier

Test the preparation, vocabulary and examples with practitioners.

02

Improve the resources

Evidence definitions, accessible diagrams, translations and new templates (RACI, product inventory, business case).

03

Deepen the implementation

Integration patterns and privacy and AI decisions, with evidence and limitations.

What version 1.x means

The site and the framework are versioned independently. In version 1.x the concept names and the common baseline are stable; texts, examples and templates may improve between minor versions. Earlier versions (identified as 0.1) remain recorded in the repository.

Framework, KDV and Kolmeia

Who is who.

The method is open; implementations and services are optional.

KDV FrameworkThe open method (CC BY 4.0). Free to read, adapt and apply with any tool.
KolmeiaThe open-source base, in development, that implements the method on a data lakehouse.
KDV Studio · KDV CloudOptional implementations: in the customer's environment or operated by KDV.
KDV EcosystemsThe company that maintains the framework and offers optional implementation and services.
Lab of Codes & KolmeiaIdentified operator of this site, for privacy purposes (contact: info@kolmeia.io).

Use, adapt and give credit

Original texts, diagrams and templates: CC BY 4.0. Site code: MIT. KDV trademarks and third-party references keep their own rights.

Contact

Questions about the framework: open an issue. Interested in applying it with support: talk to KDV.
